title: Claims Desk Reference — Northloop Protect Plans Filing Windows, Decision Time and Claim Limits
content:
For the Northloop Protect Plans, a claim must be filed within the claim filing window, counted in calendar days after the incident date; an incident that occurred during the term may still be filed during a grace period of calendar days after the coverage end date. Claims are decided within a set number of business days, only a set number of claims may be open on a plan at once, some failure types need photos of the damage, and accident claims are limited per rolling 12 months.

## Desk reference by plan

| Plan | Filing window after the incident date | Grace after the coverage end date for an in-term incident | Claim decided within | Claims open at once | Failure types needing photos of the damage | Approved accident claims allowed in any rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 | None | Not applicable (no accident cover) |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 | None | Not applicable (no accident cover) |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 | None | Not applicable (no accident cover) |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 | Accidental damage, liquid damage, cracked screen | 2 |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 | Accidental damage, liquid damage, cracked screen | 2 |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 | Accidental damage, liquid damage, cracked screen | 3 |

## Points of reference

- **Two clocks, two anchors.** The filing window runs from the incident date; the grace period runs from the coverage end date and applies to incidents that occurred during the term.
- **Calendar versus business days.** Filing and grace periods are counted in calendar days; the decision period is counted in business days.
- **Accident claim allowance.** Protect 4-Year Accident Protection allows 3 approved accident claims in any rolling 12 months; Protect 2-Year and 3-Year Accident Protection allow 2. The Extended Warranty plans carry no accident cover, so no allowance applies.
- **Photos.** Photos of the damage are needed for accidental damage, liquid damage and cracked screen claims on the Accident Protection plans; no failure type on an Extended Warranty plan needs them.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An incident occurs on a hypothetical day during the term of a Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty plan. A claim filed on the 20th calendar day after the incident date is within the 30-day filing window; a claim filed on the 40th calendar day after it is outside the window.
- A Protect 3-Year Accident Protection plan has a hypothetical coverage end date; a cracked screen happened 10 days before that date. A claim filed 15 calendar days after the coverage end date is within the 30-day grace and is also within 30 calendar days of the incident date.
